title: TRAI Direction: mandatory adoption of 1600-series numbers by IRDAI regulated entities (re-fetched; sha256 identical to round-1 copy)
note: Para 9(i)-(iii): "all entities regulated by IRDAI"; adoption by 2026-02-15; no service/transactional voice calls from other numbers "even with the explicit or inferred consent"; non-adopters treated as unregistered telemarketers on complaint. No annexure or phasing (contrast R02).

title: TRAI Direction: phase-wise 1600 adoption by RBI, SEBI, PFRDA entities
note: Annexure-I: SEBI intermediaries other than MFs/AMCs and QSBs are "voluntary adoption for time being"; PFRDA only CRAs and PFM-PoPs. IRDAI direction has no such carve-out.

title: IRDAI Circular IRDAI/PP&GR/CIR/MISC/02/01/2026: Implementation of TRAI Direction on mandatory adoption of 1600-series (to All Insurers and Insurance Intermediaries)
note: Addressed to "All Insurers and Insurance Intermediaries"; 1600 for all service and transactional voice calls by 2026-02-15; non-compliance = TRAI unregistered-telemarketer action plus IRDAI action; Annexure-I lists nodal officers of 8 access providers (QTL, TTLS, VIL, Airtel, RCOM, Satzilio/STPL, Jio, BSNL). PDF created 2026-01-07.

title: TRAI PR 135/2025: Direction mandating phase-wise 1600 adoption (RBI/SEBI/PFRDA)
note: About 485 entities / 2,800+ numbers on 1600 before mandate; other SEBI intermediaries "may voluntarily migrate ... after verification of their registration details".

title: TRAI PR 151/2025: Direction mandating 1600 adoption by IRDAI entities
note: About 570 entities / 3,000+ numbers on 1600 (all BFSI + govt) at 2025-12-17. No later entity count found.

title: TRAI PR 91/2026: clarification on 1600 and 140 series
note: 1600 for service and transaction calls by RBI/SEBI/IRDAI/PFRDA entities "to their existing customers"; no tagging/blocking/filtering of 1600 calls permitted.

title: TRAI PR 111/2026: Q1 FY27 UCC highlights
note: 1.15 bn calls originated from 1600 numbers in Q1 FY27 (round-1 S11).

title: Tata Tele Business Services: 1600 Phone Number Series page + FAQ
note: DLT header+template registration mandatory; delivered via SIP trunk, PRI or Internet telephony; pan-India circle-wise allocation; "can only be issued to the entities regulated by RBI, IRDAI, SEBI, and PFRDA". No document list, no price.

title: Plivo docs: 160-Series Numbers (BFSI provisioning)
note: Eligibility: valid licence or registration from a financial regulator declared on BFSI Customer Application Form; roles PE (BFSI business) vs TM (entity placing the call) vs VNO (Plivo); Tata DLT only; TM must be registered in Mumbai or Karnataka; regulator certificate + NOC uploaded at voice-header registration; ~7-12 business days; one NOC per number.

title: Plivo docs: XML <Stream> audio streaming
note: Bidirectional WebSocket streaming, L16 8/16/24 kHz or mu-law 8 kHz. Page does not mention 160-series; applicability to 160 numbers is inference (numbers live on the same account).

title: Vobiz docs: 140 & 160 Series Number Acquisition Guide
note: 140/160 numbers outbound only (inbound via DID); 160 Scenario 1 (entity acquires from any operator, routed to Vobiz IP/DC, assigned to Vobiz DLT ID) and Scenario 2 (Vobiz acquires; Tata DLT only); docs: LOI, GST, PAN, signatory KYC, Tata DLT ID; dedicated 140/160 CPS/concurrency bought separately. No regulator certificate listed, no price.

title: Vobiz FAQ: Do you provide 140, 160 and 92 series numbers?
note: "160 Series ... BFSI sector only"; routing billed per minute per enterprise plan; request via support.

title: Exotel blog: 1600 Phone Number - what it is and how to get one
note: Claims UL-VNO lets Exotel allocate 1600 across circles; one number per circle. CONTRADICTION: says 1600=government and 1601=BFSI, which conflicts with TRAI primary (1600=BFSI+govt; 1601=non-BFSI utilities/logistics, R35/S08). Treat as unreliable.

title: Exotel blog: Outbound voice AI for banks, timelines 2026
note: Claims BFSI onboarding provisions 1600 + DLT in under 48 h and runs gen-AI voicebot with AgentStream; also contains errors (calls 1601 RBI series). Only vendor text linking 1600 and an AI voicebot.

title: IRDAI (Insurance Intermediaries) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 (F. No. IRDAI/Reg/8/222/2026; Gazette No. 479, 30 Jul 2026)
note: Aligns intermediary regs with Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Act 2025; perpetual CoR with annual fee; existing brokers/CAs/IMFs must apply for fresh CoR before 2027-01-31 (late to 2027-03-31) or cease; policy tagging to functional identity of SP/BQP/ISP/PoSP/AV from 2027-01-01, with a digital-platform proviso for CAs and brokers; CA telemarketer/Authorised Verifier regime retained.

title: IRDAI (Registration of Corporate Agents) Regulations, 2015 (as published)
note: Def (d) Authorized Verifier; def (q) Telemarketer = TRAI-registered entity "and holding a certificate issued by the Authority"; reg 25 (prior IRDAI approval; AV certificates; outbound calls only to persons who showed interest; max 3 insurers); Schedule VII (distance marketing incl. voice; only SPs or AVs may solicit; call recordings preserved and forwarded to insurer; recording notice and voice copy).

title: IRDAI (Insurance Brokers) Regulations, 2018
note: Def "Solicitation"; reg 36 outsourcing per Schedule II Form X (core functions of Schedule I Form A may not be outsourced "in any manner whatsoever"); regs 44-46 tele-marketing per WA Regs 2017, outsourcing "only to the extent of tele-calling"; code of conduct 6: broker must ensure client knows expiry date and receives renewal notice.

title: IRDAI (Registration of Insurance Marketing Firm) Regulations, 2015 (amended up to 26.07.2019)
note: Reg 3(d): IMF distance marketing only (i) without engaging tele-marketers, (ii) with prior IRDAI approval, (iii) only through ISPs, (iv) for tied insurers. Reg 3(b): servicing activities for tied insurers. Not changed by R18.

title: IRDAI (Insurance Web Aggregators) Regulations, 2017
note: AV definition; Telemarketer definition; Form U (insurers may outsource activities to WAs only through tele-marketing and distance marketing modes); Form V(g) register as telemarketer if telemarketing.

title: IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders Interests, Operations and Allied Matters of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 (IRDAI/Reg/11/205/2024)
note: Reg 3(13) "Solicitation" = approaching a prospect or policyholder "with a view to persuading ... to purchase or to renew"; reg 53(2) offshore outsourcing by insurers: "All original policyholder records continue to be maintained in India"; reg 58(1)(f) repeals Outsourcing Regs 2017.

title: Master Circular on Protection of Policyholders Interests 2024 (IRDAI/PP&GR/CIR/MISC/117/9/2024)
note: Addressed to insurers and distribution channels; ch IX repeal list (30 items) does not include the 2011 Distance Marketing Guidelines.

title: Master Circular on Operations and Allied Matters of Insurers (IRDAI/PPGR/CIR/MISC/97/06/2024)
note: Scanned PDF, read from page images: ch III outsourcing (17.2 excludes activities permitted to intermediaries; 21.1 prohibited list); ch IX para 46 renewal commission on orphan policies per board policy; ch X repeal list (11 items) excludes the 2011 guidelines.

title: IRDAI Guidelines on Distance Marketing of Insurance Products (2011), document-detail 366441
note: Still published on irdai.gov.in on 2026-10-17; not in the repeal lists of R24 or R25. Covers insurers/brokers/CAs; tele-caller defined. Operative intermediary rules now sit in R19-R22.

title: IRDAI (Maintenance of Information by the Regulated Entities and Sharing of Information by the Authority) Regulations, 2025 (F. No. IRDAI/Reg/4/211/2025)
note: Reg 9(iii) insurers: policy and claim records "in data centres located and maintained in India only"; reg 13 intermediaries: all required records at PPB in India, branches, or "data centres located and maintained in India"; reg 16 retention min 10 years; Sch II: renewal-business record, telecaller/AV/telemarketer names, "record of all phone numbers used for solicitation"; reg 18 repeals Maintenance of Insurance Records Regs 2015.

title: IRDAI (Maintenance of Insurance Records) Regulations, 2015 (repealed by R27)
note: Reg 3(9) records "held in data centres located and maintained in India only" (insurers). Superseded by R27.

title: IRDAI Information and Cyber Security Guidelines, 2023 (IRDAI/GA&HR/GDL/MISC/88/04/2023), full text
note: Applies to insurers and intermediaries (brokers, CAs, WAs, TPAs, IMFs...); logging policy item 14: ICT infrastructure logs kept 180 days "within the Indian jurisdiction" per CERT-In. No general policyholder-data localisation clause found by keyword search of the 305-page text.

title: IRDAI Information and Cyber Security Guidelines, 2026 - cover circular IRDAI/GA&HR/CIR/MISC/51/4/2026
note: Supersedes 2023 version; applies to all intermediaries from current FY. Annexure-B (the guidelines themselves) was NOT retrieved: only the 2-page cover is linked on the guidelines page. Gap.

title: IRDAI (Expenses of Management, including Commission, of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 (F. No. IRDAI/Reg/2/196/2024)
note: In force 2024-04-01; commission defined as paid to agent/intermediary "for soliciting or procuring or transacting insurance business"; board-approved commission policy; overall EoM cap 30% of GWP (general), 35% (standalone health); repeals Payment of Commission Regs 2023.

title: IRDAI (Payment of Commission) Regulations, 2023
note: In force 2023-04-01; removed product-wise caps in favour of board policy within EoM; repealed 2016 commission regs; itself repealed by R31.

title: Master Circular on Expenses of Management, including Commission, of Insurers, 2024
note: Board commission policy must be commensurate with effort "to acquire and sustain" business; "Any new commission structure shall not apply to already sold policies".

title: IRDAI Guidelines on Point of Sales Person - Non-Life & Health Insurers (IRDA/Int/GDL/ORD/183/10/2015)
note: PoSP is an individual engaged by an insurer or intermediary; motor package/TP, PA, travel, home; intermediary responsible for PoSP conduct.

title: TRAI TCCCPR (Third Amendment) Regulations 2026 (05 of 2026) incl. Explanatory Memorandum
note: Commencement "after thirty days" (sixty for regs 4, 6, 8(a), 18; ninety for Annexure) "from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette"; A2P def; relationship (ii) 7-day inquiry; (bh) service call; reg 4 A2P declaration; reg 35A Rs 0.05/min with 140/1600/1601 exemption.
